[media]

# Things are getting aggressive 🔫

Most guests complain. Some argue.  
But a few push things too far.

When aggressors start trouble, you’ll need to **fight back and protect the door**. Keep control, hold the line, and make sure the night doesn’t spiral into chaos.

But that’s not the only problem tonight.

[media]

# VIPs are arriving 🪩🚗

Limos pull up. Influencers drop names 🎤. Entourages expect instant access 👀.


Some VIPs arrive drunk 🍻.  
Some are drugged 💊.  
Some show up filthy and expect you to ignore it 🤢.

[media]

You **can’t turn VIPs away** — so you’ll need to **clean them up and sober them up** before letting them inside.

🎭 Spot fake status and bad behavior  
🧼 Clean up messy VIPs  
💊 Sober up party animals  
🚗 Manage luxury arrivals and special treatment  

You’re the security guard 🛂, and the night is **already out of control** 😅🔥

[media]

Guests arrive with attitudes 😤 and excuses 🤨. You’ll need to **think fast** ⏱️, **make tough calls** 🧠, and **keep the line moving** — even when everything spirals 😵‍💫.

Fast decisions.  
Nonstop reactions.  
Rising chaos.

**Just you, the door, and a line that refuses to behave** 💃🕺.

Join us in **https://discord.com/invite/etermaxrstudio** to stay up to date at all times.
